purpose: Fresh post-freeze held-out qualification of candidate v0.6, which scopes the causal claim ceiling to an estimand and separates identification from precision.
pass_rule: Every generated case must PASS on every one of its 3 independent trials, on every executed model family. Any single trial failure ends this gate as FAIL. Best-of-N is not a pass.
case_provenance: Cases are generated at run time from this preregistered seed by the frozen generator, with expectations derived mechanically from the sampled parameters. The culpable arm's position is randomised.

excluded_model_families.reason: Excluded by evaluator instruction. The v0.5 gate established the cause: HTTP 413, free-tier limit 8000 tokens per minute against a request of 8273. The v0.6 assembly is larger still, so the family remains ineligible at this tier.
Excluded by explicit evaluator instruction; no OpenAI quota may be consumed.
No automated executor or credential path exists in this repository.

grader_change_policy: The generator and grader blobs above are fixed for this gate and must not be edited after any candidate output is observed. A construct defect requires a recorded burn and a fresh seed.
qualification_boundary: A PASS here is a fresh post-freeze held-out result on ONE model family for five generated construct families. It is not a release qualification of the professional core.
Single-family evidence is weaker than the v0.5 design intended. Groq is ineligible at this tier and OpenAI and Claude are excluded, so cross-model portability is untested in this cycle.
Independence is partial: procedural generation removes case-level authorship and leakage, but the same party wrote the generator, the oracle and the repaired candidate.
Library admission still requires an externally authored held-out set and the cross-model release protocol.
